programs.title: Come Dine With Me
programs.desc: Kicking off this week is business woman and Queen of Etiquette Rebecca who's going all out to impress her guests with a sophisticated dinner party full of fancy high end food.

programs.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programs.desc: Trailblazing entertainer Jean Kittson and celebrated food writer Ella Mittas have heard that Greece is the word, and they're here to make a Greek feast with Adam.

programs.title: Cheese Slices
programs.desc: Will travels to meet the last two farm producers of cloth bound cheddar in the county that still make cheese from raw milk by hand. How it is made, and the all important cheddaring process is explained, before we visit a cider maker and the famous gorge and caves of Cheddar. Then it's time to cut and grade the cheese with Randolph Hodgson of Neal's Yard Dairy fame at London's Borough Market.

programs.title: Buddy Valastro's Cake Dynasty
programs.desc: When Buddy is tasked with making a cake for International Country Superstar Walker Hayes, the team must find a way to transform the lyrics to his hit song \.

programs.title: Bring A Plate
programs.desc: Nimi serves up her favourite vegetarian Punjabi dish, Poori-Chole. Even though some guests can't eat spicy food, Nimi shares how to enjoy the dish using yoghurt and pickles so everyone can enjoy it.

programs.title: Instant Italian
programs.desc: Anna puts a fresh twist on everyday sandwiches by creating a hearty Neapolitan Panini, similar to an Italian version of a bacon, egg, and cheese sandwich. She also makes a savory, swirled panini called Italian Girelle.
